title: Fireworks damage complaint before Police Commission
summary: At its October 7 meeting, the commission heard that an investigation of a family's fireworks damage complaint has not happened after nine months, because the chosen investigator has not replied. The chair will ask other county investigators to take the case and put the matter on the next agenda. A police official will review video footage and report back, and the department will open an administrative investigation if wrongdoing is found.
